params.name: category
params.description: Filter by risk category

params.name: severity
params.description: Filter by risk severity

items.docs:
Returns a list of available risks in the UpGuard platform with detailed info.

Some risks in the platform are generic risks like "exposed_service:*". The values of some of the fields for these risks
depends on the details of the risk, e.g. which particular service is exposed. As such these fields are omitted from the response.

To get the full details for a specific risk, e.g. "exposed_service:FTP", use the risk details endpoint which will return
the full information for the particular service.

Previously provisional risks that are now scored will appear in the list of risks introduced.

params.name: vendor_labels
params.description:
Filter on vendor labels using the label’s name. By default, any matching vendor will be
returned. Use vendor_label_ids_match_all to require all labels to be present. If the label
does not exist, 422 will be returned.

params.name: vendor_label_ids_match_all
params.description:
If true, will only return vendors that match ALL of the provided label IDs.
If false or omitted, vendors matching ANY of the provided labels will be returned.

params.name: include_unlabeled
params.description: If true, will include vendors that have no labels applied when vendor_label_ids is provided.

params.name: min_score
params.description:
Filter vendors to those with a score greater than or equal to this value.
Valid range: 0-950.

params.name: max_score
params.description:
Filter vendors to those with a score less than or equal to this value.
Valid range: 0-950.

params.name: name_prefix
params.description: Filter vendors whose name starts with the given prefix (case-insensitive).

params.name: vendor_ids
params.description: Filter to only return vendors with the specified vendor IDs.

params.name: vendor_label_ids_do_not_match
params.description:
If true, will only return vendors that DO NOT match ANY of the provided label IDs.
This is mutually exclusive with vendor_label_ids_match_all.

params.name: vendor_tiers
params.description:
Filter watched vendors to those in the specified tiers.
Valid values: 1-5.

params.name: portfolios
params.description:
Filter by portfolio IDs. Only vendors in these portfolios will be returned.
If the portofilo does not exist, 422 will be returned.

params.name: assessed_vendors_only
params.description: If true, will return only vendors with a published assessment.

params.name: questionnaire_type_ids
params.description:
Filter by questionnaire type IDs. Only vendors with these questionnaire types will be returned.
Available questionnaire types can be found at /api/public/vendor/questionnaire_types.

params.name: vendor_date_added_start
params.description:
Start of date added range filter (RFC3339 format).
Filters vendors added on or after this date.

params.name: vendor_date_added_end
params.description:
End of date added range filter (RFC3339 format).
Filters vendors added on or before this date.

params.name: vendor_date_added_before
params.description: If true, filter to vendors added before vendor_date_added_end.

params.name: vendor_date_added_between
params.description: If true, filter to vendors added between start and end dates.

params.name: page_size
params.description:
The number of results to return per page.
Valid values range from 10 to 2000.
Defaults to 100 if not specified.

params.name: page_token
params.description:
Token to retrieve a specific page of results.
Omit to retrieve the first page.
Use the `next_page_token` from the previous response to get the next page.

items.docs:
Returns an overview of all risks affecting vendors that match the specified filter criteria or all vendors.
This endpoint provides a consolidated view of cybersecurity risks.

The response includes the total number of vendors matching your filter and a list of all risks found,
with details about how many vendors are affected by each risk.

Results are paginated. Use the `page_size` parameter to control how many results are returned per page

params.description: The vendor's primary hostname

items.docs:
Returns a list of hostnames for a specific vendor that are affected by a specific risk.
This endpoint provides detailed information about which hostnames have failed a particular
risk check including the detection date and last scan date.

The vendor can be identified either by `vendor_id` (for webless vendors) or `vendor_primary_hostname` (for vendors with or without a web presence).
Exactly one identifier must be provided.

Required API key permissions: `VendorRisk` (select when creating API k
